text:
## Quality Assurance  
### Standing Order Checklist  
**Before Activation:**
- [ ] Source account verified
- [ ] Payee information valid (account/sort code format correct)
- [ ] Amount reasonable and > £0
- [ ] Frequency valid
- [ ] Start date is future date
- [ ] Customer confirmation received  
**Monthly Audit:**
- [ ] 10+ standing orders reviewed
- [ ] Correct execution on scheduled date
- [ ] Correct amount transferred
- [ ] Correct recipient received funds
- [ ] Customer satisfied (no complaints)  
---

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Quality Assurance
raw_entities.description: A quality assurance procedure for standing orders that includes pre-activation verification checks and monthly audit reviews. The process ensures source account validity, payee information accuracy, amount reasonableness, frequency validity, future start dates, and customer confirmation before activation, followed by monthly audits of 10+ standing orders to verify correct execution, amount transfer, recipient receipt, and customer satisfaction.

raw_entities.name: Source Account Verification
raw_entities.description: Pre-activation verification step that confirms the source account is valid and eligible for standing order setup.

raw_entities.name: Payee Information Validation
raw_entities.description: Pre-activation verification step that validates payee account and sort code format to ensure correct recipient identification.
context: Payee information valid (account/sort code format correct)

raw_entities.name: Amount Reasonableness Check
raw_entities.description: Pre-activation verification step that confirms the standing order amount is reasonable and greater than zero.

raw_entities.name: Frequency Validation
raw_entities.description: Pre-activation verification step that confirms the standing order frequency is valid and properly configured.

raw_entities.name: Start Date Future Date Verification
raw_entities.description: Pre-activation verification step that ensures the standing order start date is set to a future date.

raw_entities.name: Customer Confirmation Receipt
raw_entities.description: Pre-activation verification step that confirms the customer has provided explicit confirmation for the standing order setup.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Execution Audit
raw_entities.description: Monthly audit step that reviews 10 or more standing orders to verify correct execution on scheduled dates.

raw_entities.name: Amount Transfer Verification
raw_entities.description: Monthly audit step that confirms the correct amount was transferred in each standing order.

raw_entities.name: Recipient Fund Receipt Confirmation
raw_entities.description: Monthly audit step that verifies the correct recipient received the standing order funds.

raw_entities.name: Customer Satisfaction Review
raw_entities.description: Monthly audit step that confirms customer satisfaction with standing order execution and records any complaints.

raw_entities.name: Quality Assurance Reviewer
raw_entities.description: The role responsible for executing the standing order quality assurance checklist, including pre-activation verification and monthly audit reviews.
